summary: Eurofins is french laboratory group, founded in 1987. Type: listed company. About 62,000 employees (Wikidata). Revenue Q4916 6.5 billion (2023). Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 78% of its 9 jobs here don't ask for Dutch. News, last 3 months: 17 about acquisitions; 6 about growth or hiring.

insights.one_liner: Global lab testing group with sites across the Netherlands; IND sponsor, many visa mentions, roles for life-science graduates outside the Randstad.

culture.text: Staff mostly studied chemistry, biology and biotechnology.
A network of independent companies with over 950 labs, running more than 450 million tests a year.

open.text: Three Dutch Eurofins labs, including Analytico, Bactimm and BioPharma Product Testing Leiden, are IND recognised sponsors.
Top schools include Katowice, Silesia, Nantes, Penn State and Minho, showing a very international workforce.

growth.text: Grew from one lab in Nantes in 1987 to over 65,000 staff in 59 countries.
Revenue was €6.5146 billion in 2023, with a net profit of €310.2 million.
Bought Element's North American life-sciences testing business for $400M.

worth_knowing.text: Sold its electrical and electronics testing business (MET Labs) to UL Solutions for €575 million to focus on life-science testing.
